messages.content: "Could you help me with a two-step conversion? First, I have 5000 Japanese Yen that I would like to convert into US Dollars. After that, I have a measurement of 15 kilometers that I would like to convert into miles. Can you tell me how much I would have in US Dollars and how many miles I would have?"
